name: KitchenAid Premium DW Drain Motor (P5-3 & P5-4)
purpose: Dedicated drain motor — W11366142 KDTM404 strip circuit (45 W SSM drain on P5).
failureModes: Open winding — F9E2 drain motor electrical
Good ohms but no run — control TRIAC or door switch
testingTips: Measure at P5-3 and P5-4 with P5 unplugged from ACU
Verify drain path mechanical before motor replacement

name: KitchenAid Premium DW Vent Wax Motor (each coil)
purpose: Vent wax motor bi-coil — W11366142 strip circuit; F10E2 / FAE2.
failureModes: Open coil — F10E2 vent wax electrical
Good ohms but vent won't open — control vent drive or fuse
testingTips: Disconnect vent wax motor harness at ProDry/vent assembly
Measure each coil separately — both must be 1890–2310 Ω

name: KitchenAid Premium DW Dispenser Solenoid (P12-5 & P12-7)
purpose: Detergent dispenser solenoid — W11366142 strip circuit; F10E1 / FAE1.
failureModes: Good ohms but no drive — control TRIAC or door switch
testingTips: Measure at P12-5 and P12-7 with P12 unplugged from ACU
Clear mechanical obstructions before electrical test
